name: Ferienhaus Hubmann
beschreibung: The Ferienhaus Hubmann is located in the municipality of Schwoich in a quiet, rural residential area. The surroundings offer access to marked hiking trails and cycling trails in the Kaisergebirge. The house has several bedrooms, a living area with fireplace, and a fully equipped kitchen. The fenced garden with terrace and barbecue facilities provides privacy. A car parking space is available at the house. The accommodation is suitable for families and small groups who prefer an independent vacation. Winter sports enthusiasts can reach the ski areas of the Skiwelt Wilder Kaiser after a short drive.
